query: SELECT lv.domain, lv.engagementScore, c.id as company_id, c.name, c.searchId FROM leadinfo_visits lv JOIN companies c ON c.websiteUrl LIKE CONCAT('%', lv.domain, '%') OR c.primaryDomain = lv.domain WHERE lv.searchId = 1680001 AND c.searchId = 1860001 LIMIT 5;
